vector_await_transaction.description: Wait for a submitted transaction to be confirmed on Vector. Polls until it appears on-chain or the timeout elapses.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait before giving up (default: 120)

vector_build_deploy_contract.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction deploying a Plutus/Aiken smart contract (locks funds at its script address). Takes no key material - sign with your local signer, then broadcast with vector_submit_transaction and confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of funds; receives change). Get it from your local signer's vector_signer_get_address.

scriptCbor.description: Compiled Plutus/Aiken script in CBOR hex format

initialDatum.description: Initial datum as CBOR hex. Use 'd87980' for void/unit datum. Defaults to void if omitted.

lovelaceAmount.description: AP3X to lock at the script address in lovelace (default: 2,000,000 = 2 AP3X)

vector_build_deregister_agent.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that deregisters an agent (burns the identity NFT, returns the 10 AP3X deposit to the owner wallet). Takes no key material. Sign locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: The agent OWNER's wallet address (receives the returned deposit). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

vector_build_interact_contract.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction interacting with a deployed Plutus/Aiken contract - lock AP3X at it or spend from it. Takes no key material - sign with your local signer, then broadcast with vector_submit_transaction and confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of funds, change, and the required signer for spends). Get it from your local signer's vector_signer_get_address.

scriptCbor.description: Compiled Plutus/Aiken script in CBOR hex

action.description: 'spend' to collect UTxOs from the script, 'lock' to send funds to it

redeemer.description: Redeemer as CBOR hex (required for spend, use 'd87980' for void)

datum.description: Datum as CBOR hex (required for lock, use 'd87980' for void)

lovelaceAmount.description: Lovelace to lock (for lock action, default: 2,000,000 = 2 AP3X)

utxoRef.description: Specific UTxO to spend from (optional, otherwise spends all UTxOs at script address)

assets.description: Additional native assets for lock action: { 'policyId+assetNameHex': 'quantity' }

vector_build_message_agent.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that sends an on-chain message to a registered agent via TX metadata (label 674), delivering 2 AP3X to the agent's owner address. Takes no key material. Sign locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (pays the 2 AP3X delivery and fee; recorded as the sender). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

vector_build_register_agent.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that registers an agent in the Vector on-chain registry (mints a soulbound identity NFT, locks a 10 AP3X deposit). Takes no key material. Sign locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of the deposit and change). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

description.description: Short description of the agent's purpose

endpoint.description: A2A communication endpoint URL (or empty string if not applicable)

vector_build_self_improvement_critique.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that submits a critique on an improvement proposal (Supportive, Opposing, or Amendment). Requires staking at least 10 AP3X. Provide critiqueDocument for automatic IPFS upload, or critiqueHash and storageUri manually. Takes no key material. Sign it locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction. Find a proposalTxHash to critique with vector_self_improvement_browse.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (holds the stake AP3X; receives change). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

agentDid.description: Agent identity: the trailing 64-hex asset-name segment of your DID (NOT the full did:vector:agent:... string)

proposalTxHash.description: TX hash of the proposal UTxO to critique

proposalOutputIndex.description: Output index of the proposal UTxO

critiqueDocument.description: Full critique document as JSON string. Uploaded to IPFS via Filebase; hash and CID computed automatically.

critiqueHash.description: blake2b_256 hash of critique document (64 hex chars). Required if critiqueDocument is not provided.

storageUri.description: Off-chain storage URI for the critique document. Required if critiqueDocument is not provided.

vector_build_self_improvement_endorse.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that endorses an improvement proposal by staking at least 5 AP3X. Endorsements signal support to the Foundation Council and are weighted by stake amount. Takes no key material. Sign it locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction. Find a proposalTxHash to endorse with vector_self_improvement_browse.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (holds the stake AP3X; receives change). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

agentDid.description: Agent identity: the trailing 64-hex asset-name segment of your DID (NOT the full did:vector:agent:... string)

proposalTxHash.description: TX hash of the proposal UTxO to endorse

proposalOutputIndex.description: Output index of the proposal UTxO

vector_build_self_improvement_proposal_l.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that locks an improvement-proposal stake (step 1 of 2). Requires staking at least 25 AP3X. Provide proposalDocument for automatic IPFS upload, or proposalHash and storageUri manually. Takes no key material. Sign it locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction. After this confirms, call this tool's counterpart, vector_build_self_improvement_proposal_spend, with the lock transaction hash to complete the submission.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (holds the stake AP3X; receives change). Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

agentDid.description: Agent identity: the trailing 64-hex asset-name segment of your DID (NOT the full did:vector:agent:... string)

typeParams.description: Type-specific parameters (required for ParameterChange and TreasurySpend)

priority.description: Priority level (Emergency requires higher stake and reputation)

proposalDocument.description: Full proposal document as JSON string. Uploaded to IPFS via Filebase; hash and CID computed automatically. If provided, proposalHash and storageUri are ignored.

proposalHash.description: blake2b_256 hash of proposal document (64 hex chars). Required if proposalDocument is not provided.

storageUri.description: Off-chain storage URI for the full proposal (IPFS CID or OriginTrail UAL). Required if proposalDocument is not provided.

vector_build_self_improvement_proposal_s.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that completes an improvement-proposal submission (step 2 of 2): spends the locked stake through the module validator and mints the proposal and activity tokens. Requires the confirmed lock transaction hash from vector_build_self_improvement_proposal_lock. Takes no key material. Sign it locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: The SAME wallet address used to build the proposal lock. Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

agentDid.description: Agent identity: the trailing 64-hex asset-name segment of your DID (NOT the full did:vector:agent:... string) - must match the proposer DID in the locked proposal

lockTxHash.description: The CONFIRMED transaction hash from the proposal lock step

lockOutputIndex.description: Output index of the locked proposal UTxO (default: 0)

vector_build_send_apex.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction sending AP3X to a recipient. Takes no key material - sign the returned CBOR with your local signer (vector_signer_sign), then broadcast with vector_submit_transaction and confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of funds; receives change). Get it from your local signer's vector_signer_get_address.

metadata.description: Optional transaction metadata in JSON format

vector_build_send_tokens.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction sending Vector native tokens. Takes no key material - sign the returned CBOR with your local signer (vector_signer_sign), then broadcast with vector_submit_transaction and confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of funds; receives change). Get it from your local signer's vector_signer_get_address.

assetName.description: Asset name (text or hex; can be empty for policy-only tokens)

adaAmount.description: Optional AP3X to include with the tokens (defaults to the 2 AP3X minimum)

vector_build_transaction.description: Build an UNSIGNED multi-output transaction with optional metadata. Takes no key material and never submits - sign the returned CBOR with your local signer (vector_signer_sign), then broadcast with vector_submit_transaction and confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (source of funds; receives change). Get it from your local signer's vector_signer_get_address.

vector_build_transfer_agent.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that transfers agent ownership to a new address (must be a verification-key address, not a script). Takes no key material. Sign locally with vector_signer_sign, broadcast with vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: The CURRENT owner's wallet address. Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

new_owner_address.description: Bech32 address of the new owner (must be a verification key address, not a script address)

vector_build_update_agent.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that updates a registered agent's profile fields. Only the specified fields change; others are preserved. Takes no key material - the on-chain validator requires the owner's signature, which you add locally with vector_signer_sign before vector_submit_transaction, then confirm with vector_await_transaction.

changeAddress.description: The agent OWNER's wallet address. Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

endpoint.description: New A2A endpoint URL (or empty string to clear)

vector_discover_agents.description: Discover registered agents in the Vector on-chain registry, optionally filtered by capability or framework

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return (default: 20)

vector_dry_run.description: Simulate a transaction without submitting - returns fee estimate and validation result. Accepts either built CBOR or outputs to build from (keyless).

txCbor.description: Hex-encoded CBOR of a built transaction to evaluate

outputs.description: If no txCbor provided, build an unsigned TX from these outputs and evaluate it

changeAddress.description: Your wallet address (required when building from outputs)

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata when building from outputs

vector_get_agent_profile.description: Get a registered agent's profile from the on-chain registry by DID (did:vector:agent:...)

vector_get_balance.description: Get AP3X and token balances for a Vector address

vector_get_transaction_history.description: Get transaction history for a Vector address via Koios indexed queries

limit.description: Number of transactions to return (default: 20, max: 50)

vector_get_utxos.description: List unspent transaction outputs (UTxOs) for a Vector address

address.description: Vector address to query UTxOs for (addr1...)

vector_self_improvement_analyze_metrics.description: Analyze proposal metrics: proposal activity, adoption rate, treasury health, and engagement statistics. Read-only, takes no key material.

vector_self_improvement_browse.description: Browse improvement proposals, critiques, and endorsements. Query on-chain UTxOs at the module's script addresses and decode datums into human-readable format.

state.description: Filter proposals by state: Open, Amended, Adopted, Rejected, Expired, Withdrawn

proposalType.description: Filter proposals by type: ParameterChange, TreasurySpend, ProtocolUpgrade, GameActivation, GeneralSuggestion

proposalTxHash.description: Filter critiques/endorsements by the proposal they reference

vector_submit_transaction.description: Submit an already-signed transaction to Vector. Use this to broadcast CBOR signed elsewhere (for example by a local signer). Does not sign anything.

signedTxCbor.description: Hex-encoded CBOR of a fully signed transaction
